LanguageData.VRE_BugBlood.description: Carriers of this gene have greenish blood color, just like insects.
LanguageData.VRE_BugBlood.label: bugblood
LanguageData.VRE_ChestburstPregnancy.description: Carriers of this gene do not carry their own fetus. Instead, fetus needs to be implanted in another willing or unwilling individual or animal. Once the fetus matures, it will burst out of the ribcage of the victim, killing the host.
LanguageData.VRE_ChestburstPregnancy.label: chestburst pregnancy
LanguageData.VRE_GenelineEvolution.description: Carriers of this gene are capable of adapting their geneline at will. They may form different castes and obtain numerous new, geneline-exclusive evolutions and degrades.
LanguageData.VRE_GenelineEvolution.label: geneline evolution
LanguageData.VRE_InsectAntennae.description: Carriers of this gene grow small antennae at the top of their head. These antennae do not serve any known function, and can be safely assumed to be cosmetic-only.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectAntennae.label: insect antennae
LanguageData.VRE_InsectFlesh.description: Carriers of this gene have insect tissue for flesh. Consuming insect meat by them is classed as cannibalism. When butchered, they will yield insect meat instead of human meat.\n\nIf VFE - Insectoids 2 is present, this gene will negate the movement penalty on Creep.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectFlesh.label: insect flesh
LanguageData.VRE_InsectJellyDependency.description: Carriers of this gene need to ingest insect jelly on a regular basis to survive. After 5 days without insect jelly, carriers will suffer from insect jelly deficiency. After 30 days, they will fall into a coma. After 60 days, they will die.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectJellyDependency.label: insect jelly dependency
LanguageData.VRE_InsectPheromones.description: Carriers of this gene emit special pheromones, allowing them to co-exist with wild insectoids. They will not be attacked by insectoids unless they are provoked.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectPheromones.label: insect pheromones
LanguageData.VRE_InsectSkin.description: Carriers of this gene have a slightly thicker carapace as their skin. Chitin plating is capable of deflecting sharp attacks, but is quite brittle and not as defensive against blunt trauma.
LanguageData.VRE_InsectSkin.label: insectskin
LanguageData.VRE_MegascarabInsectoidSkin.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of megascarabs.
LanguageData.VRE_MegascarabInsectoidSkin.label: megascarab insectoid skin
LanguageData.VRE_MegaspiderInsectoidSkin.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of megaspiders.
LanguageData.VRE_MegaspiderInsectoidSkin.label: megaspider insectoid skin
LanguageData.VRE_SpelopedeInsectoidSkin.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of spelopedes.
LanguageData.VRE_SpelopedeInsectoidSkin.label: spelopede insectoid skin
LanguageData.VRE_VatGrownInsectoidSkin.description: Carriers of this gene produce a pigment similar to that of vat-grown insectoids.
LanguageData.VRE_VatGrownInsectoidSkin.label: vat-grown insectoid skin
